title: API Reference (1.5.0) - Coda
snippet:
The Coda API is a RESTful API that lets you programmatically interact with Coda docs:
- List and search Coda docs
- Create new docs and copy existing ones
- Share and publish docs
- Discover pages, tables, formulas, and controls
- Read, insert, upsert, update, and delete rows

As we update and release newer versions of the API, we reserve the right to remove older APIs and functionality with a 3-month deprecation notice. We will post about such changes as well as announce new features in the [Developers Central](https://community.coda.io/c/developers-central) section of our Community, and update the [API updates](https://coda.io/api-updates) doc.

## Free and Paid Workspaces
We make the Coda API available to all of our users free of charge, in both free and paid workspaces. However, API usage is subject to the role of the user associated with the API token in the workspace applicable to each API request. What this means is:
- For the `#createDoc` endpoint specifically, the owner of the API token must be a Doc Maker (or Admin) in the workspace. If the "Any member can create docs" option in enabled in the workspace settings, they can be an Editor and will get auto-promoted to Doc Maker upon using this endpoint. Lastly, if in addition, the API key owner matches the "Auto-join email domains" setting, they will be auto-added to the workspace and promoted to Doc Maker upon using this endpoint
This behavior applies to the API as well as any integrations that may use it, such as Zapier.

title: Overview: Doc limits
snippet:
- **Free plan**:
- Personal docs, or docs that aren’t shared with anyone, have no limits on the number of pages or objects
- *Shared* docs (docs that are shared with anyone else) on the Free plan do have some limits to keep in mind. These docs can have up to 50 objects (pages, tables, views, buttons, formulas) and up to 1000 table rows per doc. [Learn more here](https://coda-docs.zendesk.com/hc/articles/39555798022797).
- **Pro, Team, & Enterprise plans**: no page or object limits 🎉

## **API rate limits**
API rate limits are not plan-dependent. The following limits apply to Free, Pro, Team, and Enterprise plans. Limits apply per-user across all endpoints that share the same limit and across all docs.
- Reading data (with the exceptions below): 100 requests per 6 seconds
- Writing data (POST/PUT/PATCH): 10 requests per 6 seconds
- Writing doc content data (POST/PUT/PATCH): 3 requests per 10 seconds
- Listing docs: 4 requests per 6 seconds
- Reading analytics: 100 requests per 6 seconds

title: Coda Plans Pricing | APIs.io Plans
snippet:
Coda plans reconciled against the public Coda pricing page. Coda bills per Doc Maker (anyone who creates or edits docs); editors and viewers are free across all paid tiers. The API is included on every tier including Free, with rate-limit and feature differences at higher tiers.
Coda Plans Pricing is the machine-readable pricing-plan profile for [Coda](https://providers.apis.io/providers/coda/) on the [APIs.io](https://apis.io/) network, conforming to the [API Commons Plans](https://apicommons.org/) specification.
It defines 4 plans, covering free, paid, and enterprise tiers, with named plans including *Free*, *Pro*, *Team*, *Enterprise*.
